name: Confetti
long_description: Confetti lets anybody design and build hardware projects using plain-English prompts. Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it takes one conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

launches.title: Confetti: Build hardware projects using plain-English prompts
launches.tagline: Start designing hardware with one conversation
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re Tianyi and Lucas, the founders of[ Confetti](https://confetti.build). 

We’re building a platform that helps you turn your ideas into physical things using plain English.

With Confetti, you can describe what you want, work through the details, and keep refining it as your idea takes shape, with AI agents handling the CAD, parts sourcing, and firmware.

<https://youtu.be/UhtAs4mg5O8>

**The problem**

You have ideas for things that would make your life better. Something for your desk, your kitchen, your garden, a friend. Something you wish existed, built just the way you want it.

But today, it takes layers of experience just to get started. You need to learn modeling software, find compatible components, design enclosures, figure out wiring and firmware, and understand how to get everything made and sent to you.

We experienced this firsthand while prototyping a home AI device we wanted to build. Every step opened up more questions. Which connector did we need? Would the components fit inside the case? Where could we buy the parts, and when would they arrive? Were they compatible?

We spent so much time figuring out the process before we could make progress on the thing itself.

We don’t think that should be the price of admission. Making things should be for everybody.

**Introducing Confetti**

With Confetti, you can:

* **Design:** Generate and edit 3D designs from text or image prompts.
* **Find parts:** Source off-the-shelf components and get help with wiring and firmware for electronics projects.
* **Get things made:** Get manufacturing quotes and send supported 3D printing jobs directly to print farms, with parts delivered to your doorstep.
* **Share and remix:** Explore what other makers are creating and personalize their designs for yourself.

![Confetti CAD design workspace](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=125304&key=user_uploads/2606179/1972af9c-a7ae-47f7-a430-5298623d3f93)

People are already using Confetti to work on things like a portable dynamic mechanical analyzer for their physics lab, a custom keyboard to type faster, desk companions for the office, and personalized gifts for friends.

**Why we’re building this**

We’re two UPenn CS dropouts who love building. Between us, we’ve won nine hackathons, conducted research at Stanford and Wolfram Research, and published at ICML. Confetti is the tool we wished we had when we started building hardware ourselves.

![Tianyi and Lucas by the Y Combinator sign](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=125304&key=user_uploads/2606179/ef850b2b-611b-4fdb-a027-7401ff2f87eb)

AI has changed who can build software. We believe hardware is next. We envision an age of personal hardware, where the things around us can be shaped by our habits, our surroundings, and the people we care about. 

With Confetti, more people can experiment, solve their own problems, and make personalized things that otherwise wouldn’t exist.

**Our ask**

**What’s something you wish existed?** Try making it at[ ](https://confetti.build)[confetti.build](http://confetti.build)[ (https://confetti.build)](https://confetti.build), or share your idea in the comments. We’d love to help you bring it to life.

If you know someone who’s always making things or talking about something they wish they could make, send Confetti their way.

Happy making!
